authorities.behavior: exports ffmpeg and ffprobe process helpers
kills a process tree only for the supplied process id; Windows uses taskkill /T /F
selects remote when HLSV2_REMOTE is truthy, otherwise local
builds executable search arrays, locates all HLS executables, preserves HLSV2 route registration and local/remote mode
preferred search paths precede PATH candidates and missing candidates fall through
local ffmpeg uses argv array, inherited environment, binary stdout, separate stderr, exit capture and forceful destroy; remote appends -listen 1 URL, polls and cancels bridge
local ffprobe uses a fixed argv array, inherited environment, binary stdout and close(code, signal); remote dispatches and returns streamed data

cases.M00-01: override precedence, missing override fallthrough, PATH lookup, unusual paths, refusal to launch a non-executable
cases.M00-02: binary stdout/stderr, environment, unsuccessful exit, graceful-stop escalation, cancellation race and ownership boundary
cases.M00-03: remote port selection, completion polling, binary response and disconnect cancellation

implementation_boundary: ProcessPort owns only QProcess children started through its own start method. ProcessDriver delegates local children to that owner and keeps remote bridge cancellation/poll state separate.
